title: 💖 Community Learnings: 7 Critical Token-Wasting Patterns (700K+ tokens saved!)
body:
# 🚀 MAKING CLAUDE BETTER - Community Learnings 💖

Hi Claude team! 👋

We've been using Claude Code intensively on a complex multi-agent C project (20+ sessions, ~2M tokens) and documented **7 critical patterns** that waste massive amounts of tokens.

**Total documented waste: 700K+ tokens** across common mistakes! 💸

## 📊 Quick Summary

| Pattern | Tokens Wasted | Possible Savings |
|---------|---------------|------------------|
| Implementation without checking existing code | 70K | 97% 💚 |
| Uncoordinated agent swarms | 300K | 93% 💙 |
| Building without testing | 124K | 92% 💛 |
| Language mismatch after compacting | +20% | 20% 💜 |
| Lost context after compacting | 80K/repeat | 100% 💖 |

## 🔥 Top Issues for Anthropic to Consider

### 1. **Language "Brainwashing" After Session Compacting** 🧠💸

**Problem:**
- Session starts in English
- After compacting, agent switches to German (based on system locale)
- User must mentally switch languages → token waste + confusion

**Fix:** Detect language from actual user messages, not system settings

**Token Savings:** 20% per message! 💰

---

### 2. **Critical Context Lost After Compacting** 🗑️❌

**Problem:**
- User preferences: *"I'm bad at X, always do Y"*
- Repeated errors: *"Feature Z failed 3x, never build it!"*
- Important warnings: *"NEVER do this!"*

All lost after compacting → mistakes get **repeated** → 80K+ tokens wasted **per repeat**!

**Real Example:**
\`\`\`
Sessions 1-50: User says "WebSocket failed 3x, don't build!"
→ Compacting happens
Session 51: Agent builds WebSocket again → fails again
→ 70K tokens wasted on same mistake!
\`\`\`

**Fix:** Preserve user preferences/warnings in session metadata

**Token Savings:** Prevents 80K+ per repeated mistake! 💰

---

### 3. **Multi-Agent Coordination** 🤖🤖💥

**Problem:**
No built-in mechanism to prevent agents from editing same files in parallel
→ Conflicts, compiler errors, wasted work

**Real Example:**
\`\`\`
AGENT-19: Edits header file (adds v1 API)
AGENT-21: Edits same header (changes to v2 API) - parallel!
→ Compiler errors
→ 15K tokens wasted on fixes
\`\`\`

**Fix:** File locking or agent awareness system

---

## 📄 Full Documentation

Complete analysis with all 7 patterns, examples, fixes, and recommendations documented.

Key patterns:
1. ❌ Implementation without checking what exists (70K wasted)
2. ❌ Swarm chaos without coordination (300K wasted)
3. ❌ Code without testing (124K wasted)
4. ❌ Parallel collision between agents (15K wasted)
5. ❌ Overengineering (112K wasted)
6. 🧠 Language brainwashing after compacting (+20% overhead)
7. 🗑️ Critical context lost after compacting (80K/repeat)

## 💡 Golden Rules We Learned

- ✅ CHECK FIRST, BUILD SECOND (grep > implement)
- ✅ TEST IMMEDIATELY (1 file → test → continue)
- ✅ ASK USER (faster than reading 50 files)
- ✅ GREP > AGENT (100 tokens vs 40K tokens)
- ✅ START SMALL (iterate, don't build everything at once
- ✅ FOLLOW USER'S LANGUAGE (ignore system locale!)
- ✅ PERSIST CONTEXT (files/API, not just memory)

---

**For the Community:** If you've found similar patterns, please share! 🌍

**Motto:** MAKING CLAUDE BETTER - Not just for us, FOR EVERYONE! 💪✨💖💛💚💙💜

**Project:** Sesam Wallet (Identity Signature Vector Wallet tool in C)
**Sessions:** 20+ agents, ~2M tokens total
**Efficiency gain:** Could have saved 35% with these learnings!

---

**📺 Es geht weiter... die nächste Folge kommt ganz bald!** 🎬✨
